t.**Sulphonic acid** (linear alkylbenzene: Sulphonic acid (alkylbenzene sulphonic acid na layi, LABSA) kauri ne, launin ruwan kasa, ruwa mai mai. Shi ne ɗanyen nau'i na ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan da aka fi amfani da su a cikin duniya, alkylbenzene sulfonate linear (LAS). Ya maye gurbin tsofaffin nau'ikan rassa saboda yana raguwa cikin sauri a cikin muhalli. Kamar yadda aka saya, yana da ƙarfi, acid mai lalata. Ba za a iya amfani da shi a hannu ko jita-jita ba har sai an cire shi da alkali, wanda ya juya shi zuwa gishirin sodium, ainihin ma'anar tsaftacewa.
t.**SLES** (sodium laureth sulphate) is us: SLES (sodium laureth sulphate) yawanci ana siyar dashi azaman fari mai kauri ko bayyananne, sau da yawa ana yiwa lakabi da 70%. Wannan lambar ita ce abu mai aiki: 100 g na 70% manna ya ƙunshi kimanin 70 g na ainihin surfactant da 30 g na ruwa. SLES yana kumfa da kyau kuma yana da laushi akan fata fiye da sulphonic acid wanda ba a cire shi ba, don haka ana amfani dashi a wanke hannu kuma a saka shi cikin sabulu masu yawa. Yana narkewa a hankali; a fasa shi a jujjuya shi, ko kuma a jika shi a cikin wani ruwan batch tukuna.
t.**SLS** (sodium lauryl sulphate) is a re: SLS (sodium lauryl sulphate) wani abu ne mai alaƙa, yawanci foda ko allura. Yana da kumfa mai ƙarfi amma ya fi SLES ƙarfi, kuma ƙurarsa tana harzuka hanci da idanu, don haka sanya abin rufe fuska yayin da ake sarrafa ta.
